rules.text: Floor area of the main house may not exceed 2,000 sq ft plus 15% of net lot area, or 5,925 sq ft, whichever is less. Attached garages, covered patios and stairwells count.

source.title: RS Single-Family Residential Districts, maximum floor area of main structure
source.quote: plus 15 percent of the square footage of the net lot area

rules.text: Buildings, carports, covered patios and decks more than 3 ft above grade may cover at most 35% of the lot.

source.title: RS districts, maximum lot coverage
source.quote: Calculation shall include all areas of the lot covered by any buildings including carports

rules.text: Second-story floor area may not exceed 40% of the maximum permitted floor area of the main structure.
Street-side setback is 15 ft on a reversed corner lot (10 ft on a standard corner lot).
A Minor Exception Permit can allow up to 20% more floor area for a main residential structure.
A Minor Exception Permit can allow up to 20% more lot coverage.
A Minor Exception Permit can reduce a required setback by up to 20%.
Minor Exception Permits are decided by staff after owners within 300 ft are notified; four findings are required, including special circumstances of the property.

submittal.text: Scope of work and general property information such as zoning and lot size.
Property lines drawn accurately, with the distance from the addition to the setback.
Property line, right-of-way line, recorded easements and a correct north arrow.
Sewer point of connection for any new bathroom.
Drainage notes and flow lines showing drainage away from the new work.
Floor area and lot coverage calculations for the existing house and any accessory structures.
Elevations showing that the new work matches the existing house.
Roof plan showing the new roof with the existing.
Window and door schedule with dimensions, material, finish and colour.
Dimensions outside wall to outside wall, at an accurate scale, for each story.
Residential Grading / On-site Improvements Permit Application.
